ABOUT.TITLE: Nice to meet
ABOUT.INTRO_1: Megadim Catering was born from a deep passion for the art of cooking and a love of food that warms the heart.
ABOUT.INTRO_2: For us, food is more than taste — it is aromas that stir memory, a feeling of home, and the best way to celebrate life's beautiful moments.
ABOUT.SVC_SHABBAT_TEXT: Ready Shabbat food at another level. Take our flavors home.
ABOUT.SVC_INST_TEXT: Nutritious, fresh, wholesome meals for institutions all week.
ABOUT.SVC_EVENTS_TEXT: Boutique events or large celebrations, with a home-style menu.
ABOUT.VISION_TEXT: Every dish that leaves our kitchen is crafted with the guest in mind. We are here to turn your event into a culinary experience that lasts.
ABOUT.VISION_CTA: Megadim — bringing home to your event
ABOUT.LABEL: About Megadim
ABOUT.HERO_TITLE: Mehadrin kosher meat catering — home taste, event-level quality
ABOUT.HERO_TEXT: Megadim was born from a love of good food, dignified hospitality, and a table that feels full, warm and precise. We combine a mehadrin kosher meat kitchen, quality ingredients, organized service, and culinary leadership by Chef Yinon Ankri.
ABOUT.ORIGIN_TEXT: Megadim was built on a simple connection: good food, respectful service, and love for a full Jewish table. Over time, our kitchen became a place that joins home-style taste, professional care and mehadrin kosher, so every event gets a menu that truly fits.
ABOUT.CHEF_TEXT: Chef Yinon Ankri leads Megadim’s kitchen with a focus on home-style taste, quality ingredients, mehadrin kosher and careful presentation. Every menu is built so the event feels personal, precise and dignified.
ABOUT.VALUES_TITLE: What matters to us in every order?
ABOUT.V1_TEXT: Clear supervision and care for every dish.
ABOUT.V2_TITLE: Home taste at a high level
ABOUT.V3_TEXT: A menu built for the event, audience and budget.
ABOUT.V4_TEXT: Clear answers, advance coordination and on-time delivery.
ABOUT.CTA_TITLE: Want a menu that fits your event?
ABOUT.CTA_TEXT: Talk to us — we will explain what fits, build a clear menu, and help you order without hassle.
